title: Foam plastic insulation.
officialText:
Foam plastic insulation used as wall or ceiling finish in plenums shall exhibit a flame spread
index of 75 or less and a smoke developed index of 450 or less when tested in accordance with ASTM E 84 or UL 723 and
shall also comply with Section 602.2.1.5.1, 602.2.1.5.2 or 602.2.1.5.3.
